title: Trying to promote Andriod game: Spellstrand
author: NinjaAppropriate1512
selftext:
How are folks doing promotion for their AI Solo projects?

I'm a software dev by trade, always wanted to make games, but always seemed to fail mid project due to never collab-ing with any artists or having any way to get graphics without either socialising a lot or paying. Along came AI, and it seemed a simple fix...  And having recently finished a game, man was I not prepared for the slating coming my way for using even a couple of AI backdrops in my game :(  


Despite all the coding, the mechanics and the gameplay being hand crafted... No-one can seem to see beyond some of the images being generated, incredibly frustrating.

What is everyone doing to promote their apps/games? Do you take the criticism personally? 



Anyhows, shameless plug here too:

https://i.redd.it/jpznbqpwlz2i1.gif

My mother was completely hooked on the world of warcraft leyline quests and hated waiting for dailies to re-pop, so I decided to surprise her by building them out into a standalone Android game. What started as a fun side project just for her I've shared via the Google Play Store.

If you enjoy puzzle games or just want to check out a passion project built for family, I’d love for you to give it a try. Any feedback is hugely appreciated!

  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.foolhardyventures.spellstrand&hl=en\_GB](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.foolhardyventures.spellstrand&hl=en_GB)
